thread.title: Amazon Stock Is Acting Terribly -- Bruising Market Selloff Lurking?

author: Home
title: Amazon Stock Is Acting Terribly -- Bruising Market Selloff Lurking?
text:
Watch those tech stocks.
Amazon Shares Struggling Amazon ( AMZN ) shares have dropped 4.2% over the last five sessions. Investors need to pay careful attention to the stock given it has led the broader market for most of 2018.
About General Motors RBC analyst Joseph Spak is fresh off a meeting with GM's ( GM ) CEO Mary Barra. He says GM didn't want to commit to 2019 numbers right now. Concerns ranged from commodities prices to macro pressures.
Apple Product Event TheStreet will be on the ground at Apple's ( AAPL ) big product event on Wednesday. Be sure to follow TheStreet's tech reporter @AnnieGaus on Twitter for live analysis.
